answer_1.quote: We combine OCR-assisted visual information with the language understanding capabilities of LLMs, AutoHDR achieves precise localization and restoration of damaged text.

answer_2.quote: For damaged content prediction, Top-1 and Top-5 accuracy metrics are adopted... we adopt the commonly used Accurate Rate (AR) as our evaluation metric.

answer_4.quote: we conduct two user studies (Style Consistency and Overall Quality) with 20 participants to evaluate restoration quality.
answer_4.guideline: For style consistency, participants are asked to score the font style similarity between restored and original regions on a 1-5 scale... For overall quality, participants are asked to consider font style similarity, background integration, and character accuracy, then select the best result.
